title: Futurist Farming with Precision Robots and Drones Aboard 2050
reason: Discusses future farming technologies and techniques.

tasks.task: Describe the automation and robotics in future farming.

subtasks.text: Observe the concept robots designed to autonomously scout, sense, and treat invasive pests using micro amounts of herbicide.
Note the Lady Bird Rover, a solar-powered prototype that conducts autonomous farmer surveillance and weed detection.

tasks.task: Explain the role of drones in future farming.

subtasks.text: Look at the octocopter at Rothamsted Research being used for surveillance, sowing seeds, and finding or herding farm animals.

tasks.task: Detail the use of advanced sensors and cameras in future farming.

subtasks.text: Watch the multi and hyperspectral cameras used to detect problems that the human eye can't see 24/7.

tasks.task: Describe the Internet of Things and its application in future farming.

subtasks.text: Observe how vehicles and equipment in the farms of the future can use GPS and Wi-Fi to communicate with each other and weather/pest forecasts.

tasks.task: Discuss the innovative locations and integration of future farms.

subtasks.text: Note that future farms might not all be on the ground but could be underground or integrated with local energies and opportunities.

tasks.task: Highlight the use of large-scale experiments in agriculture.

subtasks.text: Mention the BBSRC-funded Northwick Farm Platform and Scanalyser being used for large-scale experiments.
